title.narrative: Identification and formulation of nexus projects under the Denmark-Ethiopia Country Strategic Framework (2025-2029)

description.narrative: The purpose of this consultancy assignment is to help identify and formulate one or more engagements focused on a sustainable reduction in vulnerabilities among refugees, internally displaced people and local host communities that are affected by the interplay between climate and displacement challenges in the Somali region of Ethiopia. The engagements shall be formulated in accordance with Danida’s Aid Management Guidelines, in particular Guidelines for Programmes and Projects. The objective of this assignment will be to identify and formulate nexus programmes and projects engagement(s) that contribute to two of the three strategic objectives in the overriding strategic framework: 1) strengthening resilience and future opportunities; 2) supporting conflict sensitive and inclusive green growth In line with this, the engagements are to be aligned to the greatest extent possible with other parts of Denmark’s future development engagements, both in terms of strategic focus areas and partners. This is to promote coherence across engagements but also to ensure that programme management will be as lean as possible, taking into account the capacity limitations faced by the embassy. The programming of the broader bilateral engagements that address the same objectives will be ongoing in parallel with the present assignment, so coordination with the other formulation team from PEMconsult will be of critical importance. The assignment will comprise the drafting of required development engagement documents and annexes in line with Danida’s Aid Management Guidelines. This contract may extend beyond January 2025 with the aim of making revision on the programme and project documents based on comments and recommendations from the appraisal. The engagements with partners should build on lessons learnt when and where relevant.
